MeasuredTwoSATBackdoor:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    ∃ test : List Bool × List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ (φ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), ψ.Sublist φ → (test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ) = true ↔
        (∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2
          (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs))))) ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable ψ)
ExactTwoSATBackdoor:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2 (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs))))} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2 (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs))))) ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
TwoSATBackdoorSearch:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2 (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs))))) →
        PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → ∃ vs : List ℕ,
          search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
          (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)).length ≤ (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun i => decide (i ∈ vs)) φ = true
MeasuredFirstClause:
∃ split : List Bool → List Bool × List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) PEqualNP.Library.encodePair split ∧
      split [] = ([],[]) ∧
      ∀ (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause) (tail : List Bool),
        split (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c ++ tail) = (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c, tail)
MeasuredVariableRestriction:
∀ (mode : Option Bool),
    ∃ restrict : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) restrict ∧
      ∀ (i : ℕ) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
        restrict ((i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true],PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) =
          PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ((φ.filter (fun c => mode.elim true (fun b => decide ((i,b) ∉ c)))).map
            (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ≠ i))))
SparseVariableSATSearch:
∀ (D : Language Bool) (hD : D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P), ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (∀ ls : List PEqualNP.Search.Literal,
          PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ ++ ls.map (fun l => [l])) ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (φ ++ ls.map (fun l => [l]))) →
        PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → ∃ vs : List ℕ,
          search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
          (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)).length ≤ (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun i => decide (i ∈ vs)) φ = true
